**What the low-SNR E cells mean.** at low SNR the oracle picks E mostly because L and F have both failed and their fallback IS E, so the three actions tie and the tie goes to the cheapest. That is "the channel removed the benefit of cooperating", not "this frame did not need cooperation". The two are different questions and are not pooled: the second is examined on RELIABLE cells only, in the E phase, which is deferred.

## C-3 Candidate rules — WITHDRAWN

**WITHDRAWN as a set (P2-R11 B-4). The rules below are recorded, not proposed: their directions were read off development-split oracle labels, which is exactly the dependence an E criterion must not have. The E phase is deferred and will start from reliable cells.**

the candidates are read off the Rayleigh side because that is where the oracle sends anything to E at all; the AWGN table is reported beside it. every cue used is ego-local and exists before the request is issued, by the frozen cue schema.

| candidate | direction | threshold | where the threshold comes from | would fire on |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|
| `E if ego_detected_box_count >= 37` | high values -> E | 37 | the 75% quantile of ego_detected_box_count over all 1,980 validate frames -- a quantile of the cue distribution itself, NOT a value fitted against the oracle labels | 25.1 % of frames |
| `E if ego_pcd_num_points <= 49778` | low values -> E | 49778 | the 25% quantile of ego_pcd_num_points over all 1,980 validate frames -- a quantile of the cue distribution itself, NOT a value fitted against the oracle labels | 25.2 % of frames |
| `E if ego_pcd_left_points <= 24961` | low values -> E | 24961 | the 25% quantile of ego_pcd_left_points over all 1,980 validate frames -- a quantile of the cue distribution itself, NOT a value fitted against the oracle labels | 25.2 % of frames |

**No effect is evaluated here.** These are candidates and trigger rates only.

## C-4 Two situations that both end in E

* **Structural E** — no collaborator is available, so E is forced and nothing is transmitted. Rows on validate: 0. already handled: it is a feasibility condition, not a decision.
* **Discretionary E** — a collaborator IS available and could send, but the frame does not need it; E is chosen rather than forced. the subject of this section -- no rule for it exists yet.

*a share of E that mixes the two measures availability, not judgement; on this split the structural case is absent, so every E here is discretionary.*
